name: Quick Cart Recovery
author: Delwar Hossain

sections.description:
Quick Cart Recovery helps you recover lost revenue by allowing you to contact customers who abandoned their checkout via WhatsApp.

Most cart recovery plugins are complex and expensive. Quick Cart Recovery brings a premium, SaaS-like dashboard directly inside your WordPress admin for FREE.

With a single click, you can open a WhatsApp chat with the customer, pre-filled with a personalized message and their name.

🚀 Key Features

  • Premium Dashboard: View abandoned carts, potential revenue, and recovery stats in a modern card-based interface.
  • One-Click Chat: Open WhatsApp chat directly from the dashboard without saving numbers manually.
  • Customizable Message: Set your own default recovery message with dynamic {name} placeholder.
  • Privacy Focused: We do NOT store any customer data on external servers. Everything stays in your database.
  • Lightweight: Minimal code, no impact on site speed.

💼 Pro Features (Optional)

Unlock the full potential with Quick Cart Recovery PRO:
* ⚡ Live Cart Capture: Capture email & phone as the user types (before submit).
* 🤖 Auto-Recovery: Automatically organize and mark carts as processed.
* 👥 Multi-Agent Support: Rotate chats between multiple support agents.
* 📊 Advanced Analytics: Graphical reports of your recovery performance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quick-cart-recovery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Quick Recovery to view abandoned carts.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send messages automatically?

In the free version, you click the “Chat” button to open WhatsApp manually. Automatic organization is a Pro feature.

What orders are considered abandoned?

The plugin tracks orders with status: Pending Payment, Failed, or Cancelled.

Is my data safe?

Yes. We do not transmit your customer data to any third-party cloud. The WhatsApp link is generated locally on your browser.
